Recieves a { @link ReliabilityAsset} with correlation model setup data, such as:
sensorAssociationStatus, lastCorrelationModelSetupUpdateDate, lastModelConfigUpdateDate

The given asset must also contain a translationMap with the following keys:
{
  sensorCorrelation: string,
  modelConfiguration: string,
  lastUpdated: string,
}

Generates a FetchResult with the following correlation model setup steps:
Sensor Correlation
Model Configuration
Each of these steps contains the following properties:
{
  id: string,
  stepNum: int,
  stepType: string,
  stepName: asset.translationMap.sensorCorrelation || asset.translationMap.modelConfiguration,
  runStatus: string,
  lastUpdated: asset.translationMap.lastUpdated + ': ' + datetime || 'N/A',
}
